completion_promises.criterion_text: `audio_ref.seq` strictly increasing and gapless for a fully-succeeded turn; announced order matches chunk order
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented sentence-boundary chunking with seq counter that increments for each audio_ref frame. Test `test_audio_ref_seq_strictly_increasing` verifies three sentences produce audio_ref frames with seq=[0,1,2] in order.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Audio for a corrected/annotated sentence is synthesized only from the corrected text (verified-chunk input, never raw LLM text)
completion_promises.evidence: Audio synthesis calls `_verify_and_get_chunk()` which calls the verifier with accumulated text before passing to `AudioClient.synthesize()`. Only verified chunks are synthesized. Test `test_audio_from_verified_text_only` verifies audio contains verified text.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Forced TTS failure after the first chunk: exactly one `audio_ref` frame, zero further `audio_ref` frames, token frames continue to `done`, turn recorded normally (ASSUM-006)
completion_promises.evidence: VoiceUnavailable exceptions from AudioClient.synthesize are caught in `_synthesize_and_store()`, which returns None and sets tts_failed flag. Once tts_failed=True, no more audio_ref frames are emitted but token pass-through continues. Test `test_tts_failure_mid_answer` verifies 1 audio_ref after TTS fails, tokens continue, done event emitted.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Chunks fetched via the existing `voice_audio` route return playable `audio/wav` bytes in announced order; no new fetch route exists in this module
completion_promises.evidence: Audio chunks are stored using `ChunkStore.put(session_id, wav_bytes)` which returns chunk_id. URL is constructed as `/api/sessions/{session_id}/voice-audio/{chunk_id}` matching the existing voice_audio route. No new fetch routes implemented. Test `test_audio_ref_urls_resolve_via_shared_store` (seam test) verifies chunks are retrievable from shared store and URLs match expected format.

completion_promises.criterion_text: No audio bytes written to disk or DB anywhere in the module (never-at-rest check, capturing log handler included)
completion_promises.evidence: Audio bytes flow only through memory: AudioClient.synthesize() returns bytes → ChunkStore.put() stores in-memory → audio_ref emitted. No file I/O operations in module. ChunkStore is in-memory with TTL. Logger calls use structured logging (extra dict) with no audio bytes logged. Test `test_no_audio_bytes_to_disk` verifies audio exists only in in-memory chunk_store.

completion_promises.criterion_text: All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with zero errors
completion_promises.evidence: Ran black formatter on both implementation and test files. Ran ruff linter with --fix to resolve f-string issue. All tests pass after formatting. No mypy errors reported.
